rules: Do not trust local success state unless publication_ledger has matching publicUrlVerified=true.
Reconstruct all listed chunks in order and require SHA-256 to equal ce4ebfb5b07a9e05b8e1d79a920b09e1cb010f0521ee24130ff92270d284f79f before decrypting.
If an existing BOOTH draft or unpublished item with the same exact title exists, reconcile and publish that item first.
If the existing draft/item is inconsistent, 404-only, or cannot be made buyer-visible, perform a clean rebuild from the decrypted package instead of marking success.
After publish, verify anonymously that the exact title is visible, the page is buyer-accessible, the item is a downloadable product, and a purchase path is present.
Only after verification append the real BOOTH item ID and URL to publication_ledger.json with publicUrlVerified=true.
If verification fails, leave this recovery active and retry on the next consumer run.
